scope: BattleSceneController orbital marker routing and projectile presentation

findings.title: Timer expiry leaves the scene marker visible
findings.evidence: BattleSimulation.EndPlayerTurnFromTimer clears its pending marker, but BattleSceneController.OnSimulationTurnAdvanced does not clear _orbitalTargetMarkerVisual for PlayerTimerExpired.
findings.requiredAction: Clear the scene marker at the turn boundary whenever the player draft is invalidated.
